english: Ah~! Found you~!
...Huh?\nOh, me?
Yeah! I was looking for you, Big Bro~\nHey hey, play with Mie!
B-Big Bro? ...Um, I think you'd have\nmore fun playing with someone else?\nI can't even say anything witty...
Ahaha. That's fine~\nI just wanna play.
See~. Even Mie thinks about\nall kinds of stuff, you know. For this game,\nit has to be with Big Bro~.
We'll use this ball as our prop~!
A ball game...? Like catch...?\n...I'm not very good at it.
Yeah yeah. If you can throw it back, that's fine?\nBut you probably can't~.
Because...
Ahaha.\nYou can't catch Mie's ball, can you~?
U-um... I feel like getting hit by it\nwould be no joke...
Right?\nSo you'd dodge for dear life, yeah?
A slightly one-sided ball game —\nsounds super fun, right?
Okay, let's get started!\nRea~dy...
W-wait a second.
Mooore! Whaaat?\nI can't wait much longer?
Let's play something healthier.\nUm... this is dangerous... for me.
Huh? That's what makes it good!\nThrilling and fun, right?
I wanna see Big Bro running around in a panic —\nit looks like fun~.
So you believe I can dodge it?\nBut you said I'd get hit, though... right?
Big Bro's right for this game, yeah?\n'Cause anyone else could probably fight back.
With Big Bro, even whether he can run away\nis touch-and-go~.
Then, let's beg~in!
Eek!? P-please... go easy...
Wow wow!\nYou're actually dodging it!
Ahaha~. Next one~.
G-gotta run... or I'll get got...!?
Ah! Wait~!! Ahaha~!!
Huh? I thought I sensed someone\naround here~.
(...Stay quiet... she'll notice me.\nIf I'm found... who knows what she'll do next...)
Hmm... and here I was\ngenerously gonna play with you~!
Where'd he go~?\nI don't think he got far~.
Ah! Maybe he's hiding~?\nHe could be around here!
(...Gulp!? H-how does she know!?)
I see! The game's already started!\nHide and seek, hide and seek♪
Mie's 'it'!\nOkay, I'm gonna find you!!
'Cause Mie's 'it',\nthat means I can do whatever I want\nonce I find you~.
Ahaha!\nI can't wait! What should I do~?
(Wh-what are you planning to do!?\nI'm not even playing hide and seek...)
Where~? Where~?\nIf I find you too easily,\nmaybe I'll do something awful~?
You better entertain me!\nYou're hiding, right?
(...At this rate she'll find me easily.\nWhat do I do...)
(Maybe I should just show myself to Mie.\nThat way, it might not be so bad... I think)
Ah! Coming out on your own is a no-no?\n'Cause that wouldn't be fun for me.
If you do that,\nI'll do something that'll make you wish\nyou never did.
(I can't just go out there now... what do I do...)
(Maybe I should hide somewhere else...\nAt this rate she'll find me easily...)
Hmm.\nYou're not hiding somewhere\nobvious, are you~?
I'll save the easy spots for later~♪
(I can't just go out there now...\nwhat do I do...)
Gonna find you~♪\nGonna find you~♪
Find you, and grind your body to paste♪
(Th-that's terrifying!? My body... ground to paste?)
Hm? I heard a noise~!
Could you be hiding in that fridge\nwith its insides pulled out~?
Probably not, but\nif you are, that's just dumb!
D-dumb is fine...
Ah! Found you~!
U-um... please don't grind me to paste...
I wouldn't do that~\nOkay, now it's Mie's turn to hide.
If you find me properly,\nI'll forgive you the purge.
The purge!?
Yay! Ahaha~.
(I have to find her... no matter what, I have to find her,\nor I'm in big trouble...!!)
What should we play today?\nHow about dropping coins into a cup of water —\nwhoever spills it loses?
Loser gets a punishment game!\nIf Big Bro loses, he's Mie's servant.\nIf Mie loses, she'll say sorry♪
Um...\nthe punishments seem a bit uneven...
No they're not~.
If possible, I'd like to decline...
No way~.\nIt's no fun with just Mie!
But, but... it's no fun\nif Big Bro doesn't play with me.
Then, how about betting on which of\nthese two treats that cat-shaped robot\nover there will eat?
Betting... isn't really my thing...
Yeah, I figured!
I don't really know how to play with people,\nso you'd have more fun with someone else...?
If you don't play with people, what do you usually do?
Sleeping? That's sooo lonely!
Well... for example, this?
Hm? What's that?\nString? Is making a loop with it fun?\nMie doesn't think so?
You can use this to play alone...\nLike this, and like this... doesn't it look like a bridge?
Whaa~?\nWhat is this! How does it do that!?\nFun~!!
Do it again! Again!
Y-yes... like... this.
Amazing amazing!!\nHow? How are you doing it?
Teach Mie~!\nThat looks fun~!
O-okay... want to try?
Yeah! Lend me that string.
(This should keep me away from\ngames with punishments... good...)
It might be hard for you, Mie...\nare you sure...?
Hah? Obviously?\nIf Big Bro can do it,\nthere's nothing Mie can't do!
So... the way to do it is...
It's fine! I watched properly!\nFirst, I'll try it.
Like this, and like this... like this!
Huh? It's totally different...?\nWhat's going on~?
B-B-Big Bro!!\nYou didn't teach Mie the wrong thing, did you?\nIf you did, I'll roll you up and toss you in the trash!
There's a proper way to do it...\nPlease don't make that scary face...
I'm not making a scary face!\nMie always makes a cute face!
Forget it!\nI'm not playing this game!
We're switching to tag, so\nBig Bro, run away right now!!
Mie's 'it'.\nIf I catch you, it's punishment game time!
Ehhh... why are you in a bad mood...?\nGive me a break...
Okay, starting!\nGo!!
Uwaaaaah!!\nToo fast, you're too fast!!
...You mocked Mie...\nYou... mocked Mie!!
No way... what did I even do...
Um... did you do something while I was sleeping...?
Hm? Why do you think that~?\nMie didn't do anything~.
But... there's 'flesh' written on my forehead,\nand 'Mie was here' on my cheek...
Busted?\nBig Bro, you're quite the detective.
Well, if your name's written there, you'd suspect you first...
But it came right off, right?\nMie's so kind, right?
Seeing your defenseless sleeping face\nmade me wanna scribble all over it, but\nthat wouldn't be fun.
So I made it a prank you'd react to\nlater. Fun, right!
Is that... right?\nI'm not amused, though...
I'm amused.
But... you wrote the 'flesh' one in permanent marker, right?
Ahaha!\nThat's why the 'flesh' is\nstill on your forehead!
Like it's not your problem!?\nUgh... this is embarrassing...
It's fine, it's fine.\nIt's no different from usual~.
Well... I'm not exactly noticeable,\nso nobody's noticed so far.
Ahaha!\nBig Bro, you're so fun~!\nThat gloomy face, love it!
Maybe I'll scribble on everyone else too~?\nThen it'll be normal,\nand Big Bro won't be embarrassed, right?
Besides, a group of people with\nscribbles on their faces sounds like fun~.
Um... please don't...\nBesides, then we'd have to scribble\non your face too, Mie...?
No no no!!\nScribbling on me\nwouldn't be fun for me!
Absolutely no scribbling\non Mie's face!
Anyway, the other girls already\nscribble on their own faces, so it's fine~!
Scribbles...?\nI don't think anyone does...
They will eventually, right?\nThey smear all kinds of stuff on their faces!\nMie knows~!
Isn't that... makeup...?
You've never worn makeup?
I-I have too!\nI have worn it!!
It's just not very fun!!
You don't need it, Mie...\nI don't think the others wear any either...
Big Bro just doesn't know~\nHow much girls transform themselves.
Harsh, right?\nAhaha. I wanna see Big Bro's face\nwhen he sees a girl's bare face!
A-anyway...\nyou shouldn't scribble on\nother people's faces...
Booo!\nBoring...
Take responsibility and\nentertain me~!
Th-that's... unreasonable...
Hey hey, Big Bro, listen for a sec~?\nYou'll be fine, right? Right?
Um...\nwouldn't someone else be better than me...?
Huh, why?
Because I don't think I can help...
You can decide after hearing me out!\nOr what?\nYou don't wanna hear Mie's story~?
Then for the next battle,\nmaybe I'll dose you with lots of laxatives\nbefore making you fight.
Oh, yeah! That sounds fun!\nLet's totally do it!
N-no, please...\nokay, fine...\njust don't get mad if I can't help, okay?
Yes yes~.\nBut let's still do the laxative thing!\nIt'll be hilarious, trust me!
Of course I hate that idea...\nI have some pride, at least...
Tch...\nno fun...
Well, I'll do that one in secret.
(I need to... be careful with food...)
Look, look, I found something good!
Ta-daa~. A camera~♪
Too bad it can't take videos~.
A camera...?\nWhat's that?
You don't know what a camera is!?\nYou're so behind the times~.
Well, we all come from\ndifferent worlds, so it can't be helped.
This is a tool for art —\nit preserves a girl's, ahem, unguarded moments\nas a single picture~.
Score!\nNow Big Bro can see fun stuff\nanytime he wants!
...Mie just wants to capture it\nand watch Big Bro getting scolded...
Huh? I... didn't catch the second half.\nA woman's unguarded moments... like, THAT kind of pose or THIS kind!?\nYou can see those? That seems... not good...
You're so stiff...\nAs long as you don't get caught, it's fine~.\nSounds fun, right? Right?
I'm clumsy, so...\nI feel like I'd get caught right away...
I know, I know.\nIf that happens, just say\n'sorry' and apologize.
...I wanna see you getting scolded\nfor being clumsy...
That's a weird tool...
You just don't get it.\nThis is a tool humans developed, you know?\nNot weird at all.
Here, I'll lend it to you!\nTry it out right away.
There might be a paradise in it\nfor Big Bro!
I'm not really in the mood...\nbut if you say so, I'll take a picture...
Huh?
Um... what happens with this?\nWhere does the picture come from...?\nAh, this thing that came out of the front, right...
Did you just... take a picture of me?
Huh? Well... you told me to try it...\nWith this camera thing that captures unguarded moments.
Hyuh!!
What's wrong!?\nYou're covering yourself... are you cold?
Y-you can't just take pictures without asking!\nYou have to get proper permission for that!
Mooore! The camera's confiscated!\nPranks like that are bad!
Y-yes...\nI don't mind, but...\nyou're the one who told me to...
Going after my body... you're such a pervert!
P-pervert... no way!\nI just did what I was told...
I don't know, I don't know! I don't know!!\nJust forget this ever happened!
...What is she mad about...\nOh, the picture's developing...
Hm? It's just a normal picture of Mie...\nWell... fine...
Auh!
...Hm? Is something wrong...?
Um... what are you doing? Rolling on the floor...\nOh, if you don't wanna say, that's fine... excuse me.
I never said I didn't wanna say.\nHey, Big Bro!\nDon't run away~.
I wanted someone to talk to,\nso this is perfect.\nAnyone would've done, though.
Anyone...? Even me...?
Like I said, anyone~.\nAs long as you're human, you're fine.
O-okay. I'll just... be here.\nSo, what were you doing?
Putting on my socks.
I can't put them on well,\nso it takes a while.
Like this, stand up...\nand lift your leg~.
When I lift my leg, I fall over~.\nIt's hard, right?
Heave-ho! Like this~.
Auuh...
Um... why not sit down to put them on?\nThen you wouldn't fall...
No! This is my thing!
I always put them on standing up!
Honestly! You just don't get it!\nIf I don't train my sense of balance like this,\nI'll get old and decrepit.
I do think about it, you know.
So I put on my socks standing up!!\nI won't give up until\nBig Bro cries!
I won't cry, though...\nokay... I won't stop you.
It's fine... I can put them on right away~.
Auh... One more time!
...Mooore!! Not yet!
Kinda... cute... isn't she.
Wh-what!? You just noticed now?\nMie's always been cute.
But~ perverts are turned away.\nAhaha!
Sense of balance... huh.
Are you looking at me with pity?\nI hate that!\nMooore, you're mocking me, aren't you!
Next time you look at me like that,\nI'll tie you to a rock around here\nwith a sign saying 'in training'!
Honestly! Don't you think about\nhelping instead of just watching?
Huh? Can I hold you? What about the aging...
Mie's young, so it's fine!\nWhat do you think Big Bro\nexists for?
...I don't think it's to hold you up...\nbut okay, I'll hold you...
Okay~. Heave-ho...\nThey're on~!!
Okay, Big Bro's\nserved his purpose!\nBye-bye!
(Competitive... or what...\nshe's a hard kid to figure out...)
Staaare...
Staaare... staaare...
.........\nWh-what is it...?
Lately, I feel like I've been playing\nwith Big Bro a lot.
You're gloomy, and dull,\nand not cool, and I don't really get\nwhat's fun about you.
Maybe it's the reactions...?\nFeels kinda weird.
Sigh...
No, the reactions\naren't that funny either, it seems.
Oh right, that string game\nyou taught me? Turns out\nit's called cat's cradle.
I studied it a little~\nAren't I great~!
I see...\nIt's called cat's cradle? I didn't know.
...Well, whatever.\nNow Mie's better at it, so\nI'll teach YOU, Big Bro.
Look look!\nSee, I can go from the bridge\nall the way to the tower now!
Th-that's... congratulations.\nBut I mostly play alone, so...
And like I showed you before,\nmy way is doing it one-handed...
...True, with bandages on one hand\nyou can't use both. Staaare...
This won't come off?\nI forgot how I wrapped it...
...What's that?\nAre you gonna summon hellfire or something?
That's a bit much! Ahaha!
But even one-handed...\nI can make this...\nThis is the realm of solo play...
Wh-what is this... how are you doing it!?\nTeach meeee!!
How can you do that!?\nBig Bro's so gloomy, yet\nso fun!
Nothing but games Mie doesn't know!
It's not really a game\nI'd recommend, though...
Like chasing people around,\nor summoning something dangerous!\nThose are fun too.
Big Bro's kind of games\nmight not be bad either♪
Zero thrills, though. Ahaha
If you're having fun, Mie...\nthat's enough. That's all I need.
...Wh-what, that's so unlike you~!\nAhaha. Weirdo!!
I-is it...?\nDid I say something weird...
I don't need thrills...\nthey're scary...
That's what makes it good!\nNext time I'll teach you\na life-or-death game too!
It'll be so fun,\nnormal games won't satisfy you anymore~.
Well, anyway. Yeah!\nIt IS fun!\nPlaying with Big Bro.
Today I wanted to\ntell you thanks for that!
Huh? Thanks... for what...
Thanks, because it's fun!\nI hate not-fun stuff.
That's all! Bye-bye~!
Getting thanked by Mie...\nthat was unexpected...\nSo she can say things like that...
Fou~nd you.
Huh... where is this?
You're half asleep... ahaha! It's the school, obviously!
Mie...? What's with... that outfit?
Did you hit your head? You completely forgot.
Enough, enough! Into the classroom, go go!
Here's the menu. Pick something quick.
What... is this...
Can't you tell by looking? Want me to swap your brain?
It's obviously a café? And Mie's the waitress!
Getting Mie's service —\nBig Bro, you're lucky~.
...Er, thanks for that.\nBut... shouldn't it be someone else, not me...
Stop being so wishy-washy!\nPick from the menu~!
It's gonna get fun from here!
Fun...?\nThen, tea and cake... please...
Yes, ro~ger~ that!
And, the finished product is right heeere.
Why is it under the desk?
If brewing took time,\nit wouldn't fit in the 3-minute window, right?\nSo obviously, this was the solution.
What are you even talking about...\nAnd... this...
Whaaat?
Why are there wires coming out of the tea?\nAnd they seem to connect\nto this whole cake...?
Oh, you noticed?\nSee, there's an input board inside the tea.
If you don't enter the code within 3 minutes...\nBOOM! The cake goes.
Fun, right?\nA plain café wouldn't be fun.
The timer's already started.\nGood luck!
Uwaaaaah!\nThat's impossible... and what code\nam I even supposed to enter!!
Whoa!!
Hyuh!?\nDon't wake up so suddenly~.\nYou'll startle me.
Th-the bomb... the bomb cake!!
Bomb cake...?\nBig Bro, what are you talking about?\nThere's no such thing...
Huh...?\nWhere is this... and Mie's outfit is... normal...
What, were you dreaming...?\nDon't startle me like that~.
...Um, what were you doing here,\nMie?
Huh? N-nothing?\nI just happened to be passing by...
Well, Mie's busy, so!
...Hm? Mie, you dropped something.\nThis is...
G-give it back!
Oh... is that...\na picture of me...?
R-revenge!\nYou took a picture of me before,\nso this is revenge! Serves you right!
W-well... fine, I guess...
...Well, bye.\nPlay with me again sometime...
As long as my life isn't on the line...
Ahaha, that depends on how fun it is,\nso who knows.
But I'll try not to put\nyour life on the line! That work? Works, right? Ehehe.
